AMENDMENT NO. 1
TO THE CONTRACT MANUFACTURING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Amendment No. 1 is entered into as of March 1, 2025 (the "Amendment Effective Date"), by and between Northwind Devices, Inc. and Harborline Manufacturing, LLC.

If this Amendment conflicts with the Agreement, this Amendment controls on and after the Amendment Effective Date.

A. Section 2.2 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced in its entirety with the following:

2.2 Payment. Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within sixty (60) days after the invoice date (Net 60).

B. Section 3.1 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced in its entirety with the following:

3.1 Firm Period. The first one hundred twenty (120) days of each rolling forecast are non-cancellable and non-returnable (NCNR).

C. Section 5.3 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced in its entirety with the following:

5.3 E&O Notice. Customer shall give written notice of claimed Excess and Obsolete inventory no later than ten (10) business days after the end of the calendar quarter in which the inventory became Excess and Obsolete. For the calendar quarter ending June 30, 2025, that notice is due ten (10) business days after June 30, 2025.

D. The definition of "Firm Period" in Section 1.2 is deleted and replaced with the following:

1.2 "Firm Period" means the first one hundred twenty (120) days of the then-current rolling forecast.

E. Except as amended above, the Agreement remains in full force.
